```artifact
Feature: User Login and Maintenance

  Scenario: User can log in with valid credentials
    Given the user is on the login page
    When the user enters a valid username and password
    And clicks the login button
    Then the user should be redirected to the main menu

  Scenario: User cannot log in with invalid credentials
    Given the user is on the login page
    When the user enters an invalid username and password
    And clicks the login button
    Then the user should see an error message

  Scenario: Administrator can create a new user
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the user creation screen
    And enters a valid username and password
    And clicks the create user button
    Then the user should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator can update a user's password
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the user management screen
    And selects a user
    And enters a new password
    And clicks the update password button
    Then the user's password should be updated

  Scenario: Administrator can delete a user
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the user management screen
    And selects a user
    And clicks the delete user button
    Then the user should be removed from the system

  Scenario: Administrator can maintain speciality
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the speciality maintenance screen
    And enters a valid speciality ID, name, and description
    And clicks the add speciality button
    Then the speciality should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator can edit a speciality
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the speciality maintenance screen
    And selects a speciality
    And enters new speciality name and description
    And clicks the update speciality button
    Then the speciality should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Administrator can delete a speciality
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the speciality maintenance screen
    And selects a speciality
    And clicks the delete speciality button
    Then the speciality should be removed from the system

  Scenario: Administrator can maintain doctors
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the doctor maintenance screen
    And enters a valid doctor ID, name, and speciality
    And clicks the add doctor button
    Then the doctor should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator can maintain chemists and labs
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the chemist and lab maintenance screen
    And enters a valid chemist and lab ID, name, and address
    And clicks the add chemist and lab button
    Then the chemist and lab should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator can create appointment file
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the appointment file creation screen
    And enters a valid appointment ID, patient ID, doctor ID, and date
    And clicks the create appointment button
    Then the appointment file should be created

  Scenario: Administrator can view/print invoice
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the invoice view/print screen
    And selects an invoice
    And clicks the view/print button
    Then the invoice should be displayed or printed

  Scenario: Administrator can back-up data
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the back-up screen
    And clicks the back-up button
    Then the data should be backed up

  Scenario: Administrator can archive patient profiles
    Given the user is logged in as an administrator
    When the user navigates to the patient profile archive screen
    And selects a patient profile
    And clicks the archive button
    Then the patient profile should be archived
```
